newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec S&P 500 looks on track for contract high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec S&P 500 looks on track for contract high.

text.p: If Friday's strength is any indication, December Standard and Poor's 500 futures appear on track to test their contract high, technicians said.
December shrugged off August's trading range and surged higher on Friday, peeling away several resistance levels and posting the highest price since the 690.00 June 1 high.
The contract high lurks just above there at 695.00. At 1305 CDT/1805 GMT, December was up 8.70 points to 686.80.
"I think heading into next week the market's made its point and we're going higher," said Tim Ransford, technical analyst with Dean Witter Reynolds.
"This particular move is not over and the market is still strong," Ransford said.
While technicians agree that the market could spend some time consolidating from this rally, the stage seems set for the upside probe to continue.

"I think (a contract high) is very likely," said Paul Hare, technician with LIT's The Linn Group. "You have a breakout pattern developing with a gap action two days ago and that indicates normally the market having a new added strength," he said.

"On the short-term run, markets can have a little bit of a corrective pattern, but we took out August highs" after weeks of summer doldrums, he said. "That's a strong signal that you're going to advance further."
Dean Witter's Ransford pegged support in December S&P 500s at 675.00 to 678.00 and said as long as the market remains above there, bullish momentum will continue.
He pegged 687.10 as a key pivot point. How the market behaves there indicates how soon it will test the contract high, he said.
A strong close above 687.10 and "the focus really should be on how the market behaves above 690.00," Ransford said.
"Is this going to be the beginning of the next big move up?"
If bullish momentum continues, Ransford said he would peg upside targets at 703.00 and 709.00.
Jim Hyerczyk, president of JAH Trading and Research, said a one or two day correction of this rally could offer a good buying opportunity to catch the move to a new contract high.
